title: Expertise capture in workplace AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.21456v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI assistants are becoming part of how knowledge workers think and perform, accumulating the prompts, exemplars, memory and interaction histories that encode a worker's professional judgment. This infrastructure typically runs under employer or platform control. We name the resulting process expertise capture, the absorption of worker-applied knowledge and judgment into AI resources under organizational control. We develop a framework of contribution forms, technical residences and transformation families, and show that how far a contribution can be attributed, separated and revoked depends on where it resides and how it has been transformed, properties fixed by system design long before any dispute arises. translated_title: 工作场所人工智能中的专长捕获
translated_abstract: AI 助手正在成为知识工作者思考和执行工作方式的一部分，积累着编码了工作者专业判断的提示词、示例、记忆和交互历史。这些基础设施通常在雇主或平台的控制下运行。我们将由此产生的过程命名为“专长捕获”，即工作者所运用的知识和判断被吸收进组织控制下的 AI 资源的过程。我们构建了一个包含贡献形式、技术驻留地和转换类型的框架，并表明一项贡献能在多大程度上被归属、分离和撤销，取决于它驻留在何处以及经历了怎样的转换——这些属性早在任何争议发生之前就已由系统设计所固定。当工作者离职时，组织保留了由其判断塑造的能力，而工作者却失去了对该能力的访问，且随着贡献从可查验的制品转变为衍生物和习得的组件，这种不对称性不断加剧。
tldr: 该论文提出“专长捕获”概念，构建了由贡献形式、技术驻留地和转换类型组成的分析框架，揭示工作者知识被组织控制的AI系统吸收后难以归属、分离和撤销，导致工作者离职时组织保留其判断塑造的能力而工作者自身失去访问权的不对称问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "expertise capture" and develops a framework of contribution forms, technical residences, and transformation families, revealing that workers' knowledge and judgment absorbed into organizationally controlled AI resources become hard to attribute, separate, or revoke, creating asymmetries where organizations retain capabilities shaped by departing workers' judgment while those workers lose access to them.
